# EXCLAMATION

> Digital product studio in Baku, Azerbaijan, working since 2019. Websites, CRM, ERP, mobile apps, bots and AI solutions, full cycle from brief to release and support. Working languages: Azerbaijani, Russian, English.

The site is one landing page per language plus a case page per project. Azerbaijani is the primary language and lives at the root; Russian and English are prefixed.

## Main pages

- [Home (Azerbaijani)](https://exclamationdev.com/): services, process, work, technology stack, facts, FAQ and the contact form — the whole offer on one page.
- [Home (Russian)](https://exclamationdev.com/ru/): the same landing page in Russian.
- [Home (English)](https://exclamationdev.com/en/): the same landing page in English.

## Case studies

- [CRM Portal](https://exclamationdev.com/en/is/crm-portal/): CRM for real-estate agencies — listings database, Kanban pipeline, WhatsApp integration. Sales conversion +45%, database update time −70%.
- [FLEKS](https://exclamationdev.com/en/is/fleks/): ERP for a psychology centre — client balances, session charges, automatic PDF receipts. Payment and receipt handling −80%.
- [Merkuri](https://exclamationdev.com/en/is/merkuri/): cloud B2B platform for freight and customs — real-time tracking, blockchain confirmation. Paperwork time −80%.
- [MindTrick](https://exclamationdev.com/en/is/mindtrick/): habit tracker mobile app in Flutter — streaks, heatmap, lapse prediction. Retention over 8 weeks +52%.
- [Smart Fashion](https://exclamationdev.com/en/is/smart-fashion/): data-driven e-commerce platform on Next.js — recommendations, real-time stock. Conversion +65%, pages load in 0.8s.
- [AI assistant](https://exclamationdev.com/en/is/ai-assistent/): LLM assistant automating customer service — FAQ, stock checks, in-chat cart. Operator load −60%.

## Working terms

- MVP: a first working version in 7–14 days, with the scope fixed in the contract.
- Delivery: two-week sprints, a demo at the end of each, client-side access to the task tracker.
- After release: the repository sits in the client's account, three months of warranty, monitoring.
- Estimates: no price list; the exact quote follows a short brief, and the estimating stage takes 3–5 days and is not billed.
